
        <h2 class="post-title">
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jiazhengjing/p/20122379" title="发布于 2026-05-22 17:00">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">rv1126b内置phy接hub交换机芯片</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>板卡：RV1126b</p>
<p>hub交换机芯片：ip175g</p>
<p>phy：内置百兆phy</p>
<p>测试方法：将RK3576板俩个网口接到ip175g连接出来RJ45上</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>1、设备树phy配置</h1>
<p>　　hub交换机芯片不需要做其他配置 ，该芯片为傻瓜式的 ，只需要保证内置phy是正常即可</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">gmac {
        phy</span>-mode = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rmii</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        clock_in_out </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        phy</span>-handle = &lt;&amp;rmii_phy&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        status </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">okay</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
};

</span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mdio {
        rmii_phy: ethernet</span>-phy@<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                compatible </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ethernet-phy-id0680.8101</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ethernet-phy-ieee802.3-c22</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                reg </span>= &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                clocks </span>= &lt;&amp;cru CLK_MACPHY&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                clock</span>-frequency = &lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50000000</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                resets </span>= &lt;&amp;cru SRST_RESETN_MACPHY&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                pinctrl</span>-names = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                pinctrl</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> = &lt;&amp;fephym1_pins&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                phy</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">integrated;
        };
};</span></pre>
</div>
<h1>2、验证方法</h1>
<h2>2.1&nbsp;&nbsp;修改netplan eth0配置静态IP</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sudo vim /etc/netplan/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">xxxx.yaml

network:
  version: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  renderer: networkd
  ethernets:
    eth0:
      optional: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      dhcp4: no
      dhcp4</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">overrides:
        route</span>-metric: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      addresses:
        </span>- <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.1</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      nameservers:
        addresses: [</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.8</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.8</span>]</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ua5feb85a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">保存后重启复位 查看eth0 ip是否设置ip地址</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sudo netplan apply</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260522165229267-1924336814.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>&nbsp;<span class="ne-text">2.2 安装并配置 DHCP 服务</span></h2>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">以轻量级的 dnsmasq 为例&nbsp;</span></div>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">安装dnsmasq，启动默认/etc/dnsmasq.conf&nbsp; ，这里不使用 建议kill掉。</span></div>
<div class="lake-content">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>apt install dnsmasq</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">需要确保配置网关与前面静态ip保持一致</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">vim &nbsp;dnsmasq-eth.conf<br># 监听 eth0 接口
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">eth0
# 绑定到该接口，避免影响其他接口
bind</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">interfaces
# 为下游设备分配的 IP 范围，租期为 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 小时
dhcp</span>-range=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.50</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,12h
# 告知下游设备它们的网关地址是我们的 eth0 IP
dhcp</span>-option=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 告知下游设备 DNS 服务器地址（可以使用网关地址，也可以使用公共 DNS）
dhcp</span>-option=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.8</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.8</span></pre>
</div>
<p>启动监听eth0</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dnsmasq -i  eth0 -C dnsmasq-eth.conf</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260522165503656-1768053575.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;<span class="ne-text">这里将rk3576俩个网口接打rv1126b上 ，可以看到rk3576网口能自动获取到ip ，</span><span class="ne-text">并且能正常ping通</span></p>
<div class="lake-content">
<p><img alt="image" width="1533" height="910" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202605/2988421-20260522165719333-2131815562.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
